what: Experimental synthesis after the Forge TME VHIKK X: eighteen algorithms in two banks for drones, basses, textures and strange radios through a FIELD filter into a metallic DUNGEON or a diffuse REFLEKTA delay with a frequency shifter in its feedback. WARP, SPAN, MORPH, FUSE, SEED, SCAN, TIME, MIX, FEED, FORM, CELL as on the module, plus HOLD, DICE, FREEZE and an ambient reverb with five modes (DREAM, DARK, RISE, LIGHT, RAIN), and eight snapshots.
author: swtdr34mz
